关于此工作流程

这是一个 ComfyUI 工作流程，旨在彻底解决褪色、褪色和泛黄问题在多代视频循环（i2i/捕获过程）期间不可避免地发生LTX-2.3.

而不是尝试修复颜色之后图像生成后，此工作流程通过在 ComfyUI 内的预生成阶段（采样器之前）调整颜色来工作。它“预先减去”退化因素，使您的动漫和电影色彩保持 100% 美丽和生动，无论您循环多少代！

特点

  • 防止 LTX-2.3 多环颜色退化和泛黄。

  • 保持美丽、高饱和度的动漫风格和充满活力的天空。

  • 利用像这样的节点的简单而轻量级的逻辑色彩调整和图像色彩匹配.

o.en:
About this Workflow

This is a ComfyUI workflow designed to completely solve thecolor fading, washing out, and yellowing issuesthat inevitably occur during multi-generation video loops (i2i/capturing processes) inLTX-2.3.

Instead of trying to fix the colorafterthe image is generated, this workflow works by adjusting the colors in the pre-generation stage inside ComfyUI (before the sampler). It "pre-subtracts" the degradation factors, keeping your anime and cinematic colors 100% beautiful and vivid no matter how many generations you loop!

Features

  • Prevents LTX-2.3 multi-loop color degradation and yellowing.

  • Maintains beautiful, high-saturation anime styles and vibrant skies.

  • Simple and lightweight logic utilizing nodes likeColor AdjustmentandImage Color Match.
